title: Account Executive
description:
Account Executive (BDM / Sales Executive)

 

At Gaia, we help employers break away from traditional recruitment methods. Our AI platform reaches candidates where they actually are - across the internet and social platforms - turning digital spaces into talent pipelines.

Trusted by brands like Marriott, Land Rover, and Lidl, our tech is changing how the world hires. As an Account Executive focused on new business, you’ll play a key role in that shift - backed by qualified leads and a dedicated SDR team.

What You'll Do

·      Own the full sales cycle — from prospecting to close

·      Drive new business with high-quality, booked leads

·      Deliver online demos and pitch our AI-driven platform

·      Build your pipeline, hit targets, and bring on new clients

 

What you’ll get

·      £40k–£50k base + uncapped OTE (£75k+ realistic earnings)

·      Private healthcare

·      25 days holiday + public holidays

·      Hybrid working

·      Career progression and custom development plan

·      Team socials, trips, and vibrant London office

 

What We’re Looking For

You’re a natural deal-closer who:

·      Has a solid track record in sales

·      Can confidently run online demos and close new business

·      Is curious, proactive, and wants to keep getting better

·      Is organised, self-motivated, and up for a fast-paced, ambitious environment

 

The Gaia Fit

We don’t just hire experience — we hire people who’ll thrive in our culture. Our most successful team members are:

·      Self-Starter: You take initiative and stay curious

·      Collaborative: You listen, share, and lift others up

·      Accountable: You own your work and follow through

·      Forward-Focused: You ask what’s next — and go for it

 

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you love sales, crave growth, and want to sell something that actually excites people - apply now.
